summary: Each edition was reviewed independently against all five paragraphs of the selected Greek. Both preserve the desire list, death assertions, necessity of abstention, nonresistance condition, commands, personification, armor and crowning imagery, and concluding conditional promise. They retain the distinct Lord/God wording and the strong negation that evil desire will no longer appear. Servant/serve follows current policy; no repentance expression occurs here. The daughter/from-the-devil note accurately discloses the supplied, attributed edition reports without replacing the working reading or treating the Latin versions as identical Greek witnesses. No concrete fidelity defect was found. Acceptance is limited to the supplied working source and reported evidence, not authentication of unseen images, exhaustive collation, or scholarly certification.
